name: Run DISM RestoreHealth
description: Repairs the Windows component store using DISM to fix deeper system corruption that may cause updates or features to fail.

description_i18n.en: Repairs the Windows component store using DISM to fix deeper system corruption that may cause updates or features to fail.
description_i18n.de: Repariert den Windows-Komponentenspeicher mit DISM, um tiefere Systembeschädigungen zu beheben, die Updates oder Funktionen beeinträchtigen können.
description_i18n.fr: Répare le magasin de composants Windows avec DISM pour corriger des corruptions système plus profondes qui peuvent empêcher les mises à jour ou fonctionnalités.

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Executes the command 'DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth' to repair system files The script checks for and reports the exit code from the operation
